title: 第1章 外置灵根云中高塔第2章 混沌无名进入太墟
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 轰隆——！
雷霆炸响，近夜的寒气随风吹拂在脸上，让昏昏欲睡的吴语清醒过来。
趁着一闪而逝的电光，看到了高悬于天穹的高塔。
黄昏与夜晚的交界之时，青铜高塔悬空在天穹之上，尚未落下的昏暗之光映照在高塔一侧，金灿灿的颜色何其显眼。
吴语环顾四周，黑房子门口人不少，却没有一个人有异样。
不少人看向天空，也只是抱怨入夜的天气。
路灯尚未亮起，街道上略显昏暗。但灯下的广告屏早已开启，一个个新闻和广告闪过。
“‘飞升药业’招试药人，武者顶薪，改造人可申请二级合约！”
“巡查局柳队长勇气无双，再度抓捕三名修仙者罪犯！关入水渊监牢！”
“高市长呼吁公民谨慎打针，今年已有上万人通过【九龙之力】突破武者，相关部门已承担不起高额福利。”
“巡查局通告！城外荒原出现小型裂隙，大量扭曲怪物出现，请联邦公民小心外出！”
轰隆——！
又是一声雷鸣，冰冷的雨水被狂风携着，狠狠地砸在吴语的脸上。
雨...大起来了。
黑云无情的遮蔽了最后的阳光，天穹的高塔在漆黑中逐渐模糊。
吴语微眯起眼，确定自己并没有看错。
在那黑沉沉的云海之间，是有一座青铜高塔矗立！
“为什么其他人都看不到？”
他惊疑不定，
是有超凡者高举青铜塔在天空，还是大型的虚拟投影？
入夜，暴雨到来。
恶劣的环境下，黑房子外安静排着队的人却没有离去，而是冒着雨继续等着。
吴语也一样，默默地捂紧了衣服。
悬于天际的高塔，却只能自己看到......
雨越下越大，狂风吹来，一滴滴雨水顺着脖颈流下，冰冷刺骨的寒气遍布全身。
吴语打了个寒颤，急忙看向黑房子。
忽地，房门打开了。
一个戴着黑鸦面具的人指了指吴语，示意他进去。
吴语深呼一口气，大步进入黑房子中。
黑房子很小，昏暗的灯光下只有一张桌子，一个同样有黑鸦面具的人坐在桌子另一边，黑色皮质手套缓缓落下，嘶哑的声音传来。
“黑鸦的规矩我就不多说了。”
“我知道。”
吴语点点头，从兜里取出了一张卡。上边刻着‘深空银行’四个字，还有一行编码。
“黑鸦喜欢聪明人。”黑鸦面具人拿出一个机器放下。
吴语拿着卡在机器上一扫。
“嘀——！深空银行为您服务！”
content_en:
Boom——!
Thunder exploded, and the cold air of the night blew on his face with the wind, waking up the sleepy Wu Yu.
Taking advantage of the flash of lightning, I saw the tower hanging high in the sky.
At the junction of dusk and night, the bronze tower hangs in the sky. The dim light that has not yet fallen reflects on the side of the tower, and the golden color is so conspicuous.
"Tower?!"
Wu Yu looked around. There were many people at the door of the black house, but no one looked strange.
Many people looked to the sky and just complained about the weather at night.
The street lights haven't turned on yet, so the street is slightly dim. But the advertising screen under the lamp had already been turned on, and news and advertisements flashed by one after another.
"'Feisheng Pharmaceutical' is recruiting drug testers. Warriors will receive maximum salary. Transformers can apply for a second-level contract!"
"Captain Liu of the Inspection Bureau has unparalleled courage and once again arrested three immortal cultivator criminals! They were imprisoned in Shuiyuan Prison!"
"Mayor Gao calls on citizens to be careful when taking injections. This year, tens of thousands of people have passed the [Power of Kowloon] Breakthrough Warrior, and the relevant departments can no longer afford the high benefits."
"Notice from the Inspection Bureau! A small crack has appeared in the wasteland outside the city, and a large number of twisted monsters have appeared. Federal citizens are asked to be careful when going out!"
...
Boom——!
There was another thunder, and the cold rain was carried by the strong wind and hit Wu Yu's face hard.
The rain...is getting heavier.
Black clouds ruthlessly blocked the last sunlight, and the tall towers in the sky gradually blurred in the darkness.
Wu Yu narrowed his eyes slightly to make sure that he had seen it correctly.
Between the dark sea of ​​clouds, there is a tall bronze tower standing!
"Why can't anyone else see it?"
He was startled and doubtful,
Is it a transcendent person holding a bronze tower high in the sky, or is it a large virtual projection?
At night, heavy rain comes.
Despite the harsh environment, the people lining up quietly outside the dark house did not leave, but continued to wait in the rain.
Wu Yu did the same, silently covering his clothes tightly.
The tall tower hanging in the sky can only be seen by myself...
The rain was getting heavier and heavier, the strong wind was blowing, and drops of rainwater flowed down the neck, and the icy cold air spread all over the body.
Wu Yu shuddered and hurriedly looked at the black house.
Suddenly, the door opened.
A man wearing a black crow mask pointed at Wu Yu and motioned for him to come in.
Wu Yu took a deep breath and strode into the dark room.
The black room was small, with only one table under dim light. A man with a black crow mask sat on the other side of the table. Black leather gloves slowly fell down, and a hoarse voice came from the room.
"I won't go into detail about the rules of the Black Crow."
"I know."
Wu Yu nodded and took out a card from his pocket. Engraved on it are the words 'Deep Space Bank' and a line of code.
"Black crows like smart people." The man in the black crow mask took out a machine and put it down.
Wu Yu took the card and scanned it on the machine.
"Beep——! Deep Space Bank is at your service!"
